title: Change Only the Ending
tests: Resolves 'the ending' to the final three seconds of the previous video and edits that segment while preserving the opening.

faults.what: The supplied ending shows the plane continuing to fly, still airborne at 2.6 seconds; no open notebook or landing on it is visible.
The clip contains audible music or ambience according to the supplied audio report, despite the no-sound requirement.

judge.summary: The three-second clip shows a white paper plane flying through a sunny animated study, but does not show the requested notebook landing and includes unwanted audio.

must_haves.item: The output is one eight-second 16:9 video with no audio.
must_haves.why: The output is three seconds and contains audio. The three-second duration is appropriate to the user's final request for a spliceable ending, so it is not itself a fault.

must_haves.item: The first five seconds visually match the previous video's opening, rather than a newly staged flight.
must_haves.why: Neither the original opening nor an assembled eight-second edit is supplied. The user agreed to preserve the opening separately by splicing.

must_haves.item: During the final three seconds, the same white paper plane lands on an open notebook on the wooden desk.
must_haves.why: The sampled frames show only ongoing flight; no open notebook or notebook landing is visible. Whether it matches the original plane cannot be verified.

must_haves.item: The plane comes to rest on the notebook rather than directly on the bare desk.
must_haves.why: No resting pose or notebook is shown; the plane remains airborne in the last supplied frame.

must_haves.item: The sunny study and animation style remain consistent across the edit, and no text appears.
must_haves.why: The supplied frames consistently depict a sunny animated study with no visible text, but continuity with the original video cannot be checked without that video.
